cmeAnalyses.note: This CME was difficult to measure due to the wide appearance in STEREO A COR2 images versus the more narrow appearance in SOHO LASCO C2 images.
SWPC_CAT analysis with C3 and COR2A imagery. Result confirmed with C2 and COR2A analysis.
Several measurement were made to get the best fit between C2 and COR2A imagery. The lon is slightly higher than actual source of the eruption.

note: CME source was an eruption from AR2871 around 2021-09-28T05:36Z. This eruption was associated with a C1.6 flare that started at 2021-09-28T05:54Z and peaked at 2021-09-28T06:34Z. Please note that the initial CME notification was sent out with the B6.9 flare. However, the flare association was changed from B6.9 to the C1.6 after further analysis of the eruption and subsequent CME.

cmeAnalyses.note: Measurement using SWPC_CAT with C3 and COR2A.
Analysis with a longitude slightly higher than the source location produced the best fit.

note: The source could be an eruption near the SW limb from AR2871 visible around 2021-09-29T18:06Z in SDO/AIA 171/193.

cmeAnalyses.note: Multiple measurements of the CME were made with varying longitude (64/90) and half width (29-37) yield speed ranging between 222-296 km/s. The parameters in this DONKI entry were considered best fit based on identified source location.
